package.name: Knowledge Router
package.description: A cheaper Knowledge Retrieval: picks the lorebook entries that fit the scene and gives them to the AI as they are. Works best with big lorebooks whose entries have short descriptions. Add the Agent in Chat Settings → Agents → Writer Agents for Roleplay mode.
